projects.name: Real-Time VR Analytics & WebGL Integration
projects.description: Engineered the web infrastructure for an immersive research platform. Integrated a Unity WebGL build into a React/Vite application and developed robust Node.js/WebSocket APIs to stream real-time eye-tracking data from the VR environment to a custom analytics dashboard. This system ensured seamless, low-latency communication between the simulation and the web interface.

projects.name: Tamil Shop Announcer
projects.technologies: React.js, Web Speech API, Tailwind CSS, Gemini CLI, Claude Code

The development process utilized advanced LLMs to rapidly solve complex language processing challenges and ensure natural-sounding Tamil output.
